message.reasoning_content:

In China, relevant criminal statutes: "非法行医罪" (Practicing medicine without a license). Also possibly "非法行医罪" covers both lacking qualification and lacking license. Could also be "非法行医罪" only. Could there be "非法行医罪" and "非法行医罪" is singular. Also maybe "非法行医罪" under Criminal Law article 336? Actually article 336: "非法行医罪" for practicing medicine without license, causing严重后果 maybe. Here no mention of injury, but still illegal practice. Also could be "非法行医罪" and "非法行医罪" is the only crime. Could there be "非法行医罪" and "非法行医罪" plus "非法行医罪"? No.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法行医<eoa>.
